notes: The page does not give pay, exact ages or the next application window. Call or email the office to ask.
name: Boston Mayor's Youth Council
org: Office of Youth Engagement and Advancement, City of Boston
what_you_do: Youth Councilors speak for Boston youth in city government. They lead their own projects. In 2025-26 the Streets Committee spent the year gathering information about street services.
who_can_apply: Boston youth. The page does not list an age or grade rule.
duration: A yearly cohort (the 2025-26 cohort was announced in December 2025)
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The page has an Interest Form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Interest Form on the Mayor's Youth Council page. Questions: myc@boston.gov or 617-961-6980.
